name: PlainApp
title: PlainApp: free AirDroid alternative
hook: AirDroid charges you thirty bucks a year to manage your phone from a computer. This app does it for free.
job: Manages your phone from a PC

features.intro: Your whole phone, in a browser tab.
features.say: Open it on any computer on the same Wi-Fi, and browse your files, photos and videos.
Read and send texts from your desktop, and mirror your notifications.
It can even mirror your screen, with remote control.

caption:
AirDroid Premium charges $29.99/year. PlainApp manages your phone from any computer for free 📱

✅ Browse files, photos and videos in your browser
✅ Read and send SMS from your desktop
✅ Mirror notifications and your screen, with remote control
✅ No account, no cloud, no subscription, 100% free

💻 Android phone + any computer browser
ℹ️ Phone and computer need to be on the same Wi-Fi network

Comment "PHONE" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
